missions.title: First Light
missions.event: At dawn Germany invades Poland from the north, west and south; in the Pomeranian Corridor the 18th Pomeranian Uhlans fight at Krojanty that evening.
objectives: Reach the courier's wrecked car in the forest
Recover the dispatch satchel
Slip through the German advance to the Polish lines

missions.title: The Kuty Bridge
missions.event: The Soviet Union invades Poland from the east. That night the Polish government and the staff of the Cipher Bureau, who had broken Enigma, cross the Kuty bridge into Romania.
objectives: Find the three cipher specialists hiding in the town
Escort them past the patrols to the bridge
Destroy the cipher notes they cannot carry
Cross into Romania before dawn

missions.title: Montevideo Whispers
missions.event: After the Battle of the River Plate the damaged Admiral Graf Spee shelters in neutral Montevideo. British agents spread rumours of a great fleet waiting offshore; on 17 December Captain Langsdorff scuttles his ship.
objectives: Photograph the shell damage to the Graf Spee from the quay
Plant the false fleet signal in the German naval attache's briefcase
Leave the harbour without harming anyone - Uruguay is neutral

missions.title: The Navy's Here
missions.event: HMS Cossack pursues the German supply ship Altmark into Jossingfjord and boards her, freeing 299 British merchant seamen held in her holds.
objectives: Board the Altmark from the ice
Take the bridge
Open the three cargo holds
Lead the prisoners to the Cossack's gangway

missions.title: Gold Run
missions.event: Germany invades Norway and Denmark. As German troops land at Oslo, 50 tonnes of Norway's gold reserve leave the city by truck, beginning a two-month flight that ends in Britain.
objectives: Clear the German roadblock at the bridge
Blow the bridge behind the last gold truck
Keep every truck moving - none may be captured

missions.title: Diamonds of Amsterdam
missions.event: As the Netherlands falls, a British officer gathers the city's stock of industrial diamonds, vital for machine tools, and carries them out through IJmuiden ahead of the German army.
objectives: Open the safes of three diamond dealers
Bring the diamond cases to the car on the Prinsengracht
Reach the boat at IJmuiden before German motorcyclists close the road

missions.title: The Mole
missions.event: Operation Dynamo enters its last nights. The British and French rearguard hold the perimeter while ships lift soldiers from the beaches and the long East Mole.
objectives: Gather the cut-off stragglers in the burning town
Destroy the abandoned fuel dump
Reach the East Mole before the last destroyer sails

missions.title: Broompark
missions.event: As France collapses, the Earl of Suffolk loads the collier SS Broompark at Bordeaux with French scientists, the world's stock of heavy water, industrial diamonds and machine tools, and sails for England.
objectives: Escort the two physicists to the Broompark
Deliver the 26 cans of heavy water to the hold
Stop the infiltrators from sabotaging the ship

missions.title: Hundred Regiments
missions.event: China has fought Japan alone since 1937. On 20 August the Eighth Route Army opens the Hundred Regiments Offensive against the railways and blockhouses that hold northern China.
objectives: Cut the telegraph line
Blow the railway in three places
Destroy the blockhouse ammunition store
Withdraw to the hills

missions.title: Sea Lion
missions.event: The Battle of Britain reaches its climax. Across the Channel, invasion barges crowd the ports; two days later Hitler postpones Operation Sea Lion.
objectives: Mine three clusters of invasion barges
Destroy the harbour crane
Get back to the motor launch

missions.title: Murzuk
missions.event: The Long Range Desert Group and Free French troops from Chad cross some 1,300 miles of desert to raid the Italian airfield and fort at Murzuk.
objectives: Destroy the aircraft on the airfield
Burn the fuel dump
Cut the telephone line to Sebha
Withdraw to the trucks

missions.title: Claymore
missions.event: Commandos raid the Lofoten Islands, destroying fish-oil factories and capturing spare Enigma rotor wheels and code documents from the armed trawler Krebs.
objectives: Blow the fish-oil tanks
Board the trawler Krebs and seize the Enigma rotors
Bring the Norwegian volunteers to the landing craft

missions.title: Primrose
missions.event: HMS Bulldog forces U-110 to the surface. A boarding party recovers her Enigma machine and codebooks before she sinks, one of the war's great intelligence prizes.
objectives: Board the U-boat before she sinks
Defuse the scuttling charges
Recover the Enigma machine and codebooks
Return to the whaler

missions.title: Litani
missions.event: No. 11 (Scottish) Commando lands at the mouth of the Litani to open the crossing for the Allied advance into Vichy-held Syria and Lebanon; the defenders blow the Qasmiyeh bridge before it can be taken.
objectives: Secure the crossing at the Qasmiyeh bridge
Silence the redoubt guns
Hold the north bank until the Australians cross

missions.title: Brest Fortress
missions.event: Operation Barbarossa: over three million Axis soldiers invade the Soviet Union. The garrison of the Brest Fortress fights on, surrounded, for weeks.
objectives: Silence the machine-gun nests covering the Kholm Gate
Lead the wounded out through the gate
Reach the Mukhavets crossing

missions.title: Before Moscow
missions.event: At -30 C the German advance stalls in sight of Moscow. On 5 December the Red Army counter-attacks along the whole front.
objectives: Blow the fuel depot
Spike the artillery park
Steal the operations map from the headquarters izba
Bring the map to Captain Orlov

missions.title: Oklahoma
missions.event: Japanese carrier aircraft strike Pearl Harbor. The capsized USS Oklahoma traps hundreds of men; navy yard workers cut through her hull through the night and rescue 32.
objectives: Survive the second wave
Bring the cutting gear to the upturned hull
Find the trapped men by their tapping
Cut them out before their air runs out

missions.title: Archery
missions.event: British and Norwegian commandos raid Vagsoy. Heavy street fighting rages in South Vagsoy, where Captain Martin Linge of the Norwegian Independent Company is killed.
objectives: Silence the coastal battery on Maloy
Destroy the fish-oil factories
Capture the harbourmaster's code documents
Evacuate the volunteers

missions.title: Sham Shui Po
missions.place: Sham Shui Po POW camp, Kowloon
missions.event: Hong Kong fell on Christmas Day. Lieutenant-Colonel Lindsay Ride escapes from Sham Shui Po camp by sampan and, guided by Chinese guerrillas, reaches Free China to found the British Army Aid Group.
objectives: Cut through the wire on the seaward side
Bring the four escapers to the sampan
Cross the bay past the patrol boats

missions.title: Biting
missions.event: British paratroopers drop near Bruneval and seize the components of a German Wurzburg radar, carrying them off by sea for the scientists in England.
objectives: Take the villa beside the radar
Protect the technician while he dismantles the Wurzburg
Capture a radar operator
Reach the beach for the boats

missions.title: Chariot
missions.event: The old destroyer HMS Campbeltown rams the Normandie dock gate at St Nazaire. Commandos destroy the dock machinery; at noon the Campbeltown's hidden charges explode and wreck the dock.
objectives: Blow the pumping house
Wreck the gate winding houses
Fight through the old town towards open country

missions.title: Zhejiang
missions.event: Sixteen B-25s of the Doolittle Raid bomb Tokyo and crash-land across China. Chinese villagers and guerrillas shelter the airmen; Japan's reprisals cost an estimated 250,000 Chinese lives.
objectives: Find the three downed airmen
Evade the Japanese search parties
Reach the river boat to Quzhou

missions.title: Ironclad
missions.event: To deny Japan a base on the Indian Ocean, British forces land in Vichy-held Madagascar, commandos leading the way ashore at Courrier Bay.
objectives: Clear the beach obstacles before the landing craft arrive
Take the coastal battery
Open the road to Antsirane

missions.title: Anthropoid
missions.event: Czechoslovak parachutists Jozef Gabcik and Jan Kubis attack Reinhard Heydrich at a tram curve in Prague. He dies of his wounds on 4 June; Nazi reprisals destroy the village of Lidice.
objectives: Take the lookout post and signal the car's approach
Clear an escape route through the cordon
Get both parachutists to the safe house

missions.title: Sidi Haneish
missions.event: David Stirling's SAS drive a column of armed jeeps across a moonlit Axis airfield, destroying around 37 aircraft in minutes.
objectives: Bring the jeeps to the airfield edge unseen
Destroy at least twenty aircraft
Escape before the dawn air search

missions.title: Coastwatcher
missions.event: US Marines land on Guadalcanal. Hidden in the jungle, Australian coastwatchers radio early warning of every Japanese air raid, the famous 'twenty-four bombers headed yours'.
objectives: Move the teleradio ahead of the Japanese patrols
Send the bomber warning in time
Rescue the captured island scout
Take the set and the carriers to the hill village

missions.title: Hess Battery
missions.event: The Dieppe Raid. On the western flank Lord Lovat's No. 4 Commando destroys the six guns of the Hess battery, the day's only complete success.
objectives: Climb the Vasterival gully
Destroy all six guns
Blow the ammunition store
Withdraw to the beach

missions.title: Bertram
missions.event: Under cover of Operation Bertram, a deception of dummy tanks and a fake water pipeline, Montgomery's Eighth Army opens the Second Battle of El Alamein.
objectives: Stop the enemy reconnaissance patrol from reaching the dummy depot
Plant the false maps in the wrecked scout car
Let their officer see the armour from the ridge, and go home
Be clear of no-man's-land before the barrage at 21:40

missions.title: Pavlov's House
missions.event: In Stalingrad a handful of soldiers have held one apartment house for weeks. On 19 November Operation Uranus begins and the encirclement of the German 6th Army follows.
objectives: Bring ammunition through the communication trench
Eliminate the three enemy snipers
Silence the machine guns in the Milk House

missions.title: Cockleshell
missions.event: Operation Frankton: Royal Marines paddle canoes some 70 miles up the Gironde and fix limpet mines to blockade runners in Bordeaux harbour.
objectives: Paddle past the patrol boats and searchlights
Fix limpet mines to six ships
Slip ashore and reach the Resistance contact

missions.title: Gunnerside
missions.event: Norwegian commandos climb the Vemork gorge, enter the hydroelectric plant through a cable tunnel and destroy its heavy water cells, without a single shot fired.
objectives: Cross the frozen gorge
Enter the plant through the cable tunnel
Place charges on the heavy water cells
Escape before the alarm - bonus: fire no shots

missions.title: Longcloth
missions.event: Orde Wingate's Chindits march deep into Japanese-held Burma; a column cuts the Mandalay-Myitkyina railway at Nankan.
objectives: Blow the railway in three places
Drop the girder bridge
Ambush the relief patrol
Rejoin the column at the river
Get the column across the line

missions.title: Mincemeat
missions.event: A corpse dressed as Major William Martin, Royal Marines, washes ashore at Huelva carrying false invasion plans. The deception persuades the Germans that the Allies will land in Greece and Sardinia, not Sicily.
objectives: Shadow the briefcase from the beach to the naval office
Make sure the German agent gets his look at the papers
Recover the briefcase unopened-looking - neutral Spain, no killing

missions.title: Murro di Porco
missions.event: Operation Husky: the Allies invade Sicily. The Special Raiding Squadron scales the cliffs at Capo Murro di Porco and destroys the coastal battery guarding the landings.
objectives: Scale the cliffs
Destroy the three coastal guns
Take the battery command post
Fire the green success flare

missions.title: Rail War
missions.event: After the Battle of Kursk, Soviet partisans launch Operation Rail War, blowing tens of thousands of rails across occupied Belarus in a single night.
objectives: Blow the rails at five points within the hour
Destroy the water tower
Stop the armoured train from reaching the junction

missions.title: Armistice
missions.event: Italy surrenders. At Fontanellato the Italian commandant opens the camp and the prisoners march out into the countryside about an hour before German troops arrive.
objectives: Lead the prisoners out through the orchard
Blow the culvert to delay the German column
Get every group into the hills

missions.title: Jaywick
missions.event: Australian and British commandos of Z Special Unit sail the old fishing boat Krait to Singapore, then paddle canoes into the harbour and sink or damage six Japanese ships with limpet mines.
objectives: Paddle into Keppel Harbour unseen
Fix limpets to six ships
Reach the island hideout by dawn

missions.title: Oresund
missions.event: Warned of a German round-up, ordinary Danes hide their Jewish neighbours and ferry over 7,000 of them across the Oresund to neutral Sweden in fishing boats.
objectives: Bring the families from the church loft to the harbour
Draw the harbour police away from the boats
See every boat out to sea

missions.title: Jericho
missions.event: RAF Mosquitos breach the walls of Amiens prison at low level, and hundreds of prisoners, many of them Resistance members facing execution, escape through the gaps.
objectives: Wait for the bombs to breach the wall at noon
Free your network's twelve prisoners
Get them to the waiting cars
Burn the Gestapo card index

missions.title: Tennis Court
missions.event: At Kohima a small garrison holds the ridge against a Japanese division; the two sides fight across the Deputy Commissioner's tennis court, grenades' throw apart.
objectives: Recover the supply drops that fell between the lines
Hold the tennis court terrace
Evacuate the wounded to the dressing station

missions.title: The General
missions.event: British SOE officers Patrick Leigh Fermor and Bill Stanley Moss, in German uniform, and Cretan partisans stop General Kreipe's car, drive him through Heraklion and smuggle him across the mountains to Egypt.
objectives: Stop the general's car at the junction, in disguise
Bluff through the Heraklion checkpoints
Cross the mountains to the evacuation beach

missions.title: Deadstick
missions.event: D-Day. From 00:16 gliders land beside the Caen Canal bridge and the bridge over the Orne; within minutes both are in Allied hands.
objectives: Take the canal bridge
Take the river bridge
Check both bridges for demolition charges
Hold until the commandos arrive with the piper

missions.title: Pointe du Hoc
missions.event: US Army Rangers scale 100-foot cliffs under fire to reach the gun battery, find the casemates empty, and track the hidden guns to an orchard inland, where they destroy them.
objectives: Climb the cliffs
Clear the casemates
Find the missing guns
Destroy them with thermite
Cut the coast road

missions.title: Bagration
missions.event: On the eve of Operation Bagration, partisans across Belarus cut the railways; from 22 June the Red Army destroys Army Group Centre in less than two weeks.
objectives: Drop the railway bridge
Destroy the ammunition train
Capture the staff officer carrying the defence plans

missions.title: Most III
missions.event: An RAF Dakota lands at night on a field held by the Polish Home Army and flies out the parts of a V-2 rocket; its wheels sink in the mud and it gets airborne only on the fourth attempt, 65 minutes after landing.
objectives: Secure the landing field
Bring the V-2 parts cart to the Dakota
Lay planks under the stuck wheels
Hold until take-off

missions.title: Is Paris Burning?
missions.event: Paris rises against its occupiers. On the evening of 24 August the half-tracks of 'La Nueve', a company of Spanish Republicans in the French 2nd Armoured Division, reach the Hotel de Ville.
objectives: Remove the demolition charges from three bridges
Guide La Nueve's half-tracks to the Hotel de Ville
Seize the telephone exchange

missions.title: Kanaly
missions.event: After a month of the Warsaw Uprising the Old Town falls. About 5,300 insurgents and civilians escape through the sewers, most of them to the city centre and some 800 to Żoliborz.
objectives: Hold Krasinski Square until the wounded are below
Lead the column through the sewers
Surface at Warecka Street

missions.title: Leyte
missions.event: On the eve of MacArthur's return to the Philippines, navy frogmen chart the landing beaches and Filipino guerrillas cut Japanese communications inland.
objectives: Chart the beach obstacles
Spike the coastal guns
Cut the telephone line with the guerrillas

missions.title: Pegasus
missions.event: A month after Arnhem, the Dutch Resistance and MI9 lead 138 hidden Allied soldiers through German lines to the Rhine, where assault boats carry them to safety.
objectives: Gather the evaders at the wood
Follow the Bofors tracer to the crossing point
Get every boat across

missions.title: Fuel
missions.event: The Battle of the Bulge. Kampfgruppe Peiper races for the Meuse but is short of fuel; near Stavelot American troops and Belgian fusiliers set a gasoline roadblock ablaze to keep the great fuel dumps from the German tanks.
objectives: Unmask the infiltrators in American uniform
Light the fuel roadblock before the Panzers arrive
Drive the fuel trucks out

missions.title: Cabanatuan
missions.event: US Rangers, Alamo Scouts and Filipino guerrillas raid the Cabanatuan camp 30 miles behind Japanese lines and free 489 prisoners of war and 33 civilians.
objectives: Crawl into position across the open field
Silence the towers when the attack begins
Bring the prisoners to the carabao carts
Hold the Cabu bridge until the column is clear

missions.title: Los Banos
missions.event: At 07:00, while the guards do their morning exercises, paratroopers drop beside Los Banos camp; guerrillas strike the gates and amphibious tractors carry 2,147 internees to safety.
objectives: Mark the drop zone with smoke
Seize the guards' rifle rack during exercises
Lead the internees to the amtracs

missions.title: Remagen
missions.event: Men of the US 9th Armored Division find the Ludendorff railway bridge still standing. The German demolition charge only partly detonates, and the Americans storm across the Rhine.
objectives: Reach the bridge before it is blown
Cut the demolition cables
Take the railway tunnel on the east bank

missions.title: Castle Itter
missions.event: In the war's strangest battle, American soldiers, anti-Nazi Wehrmacht troops and French VIP prisoners defend Castle Itter together against the Waffen-SS.
objectives: Reach the castle with Major Gangl's men
Hold the walls
Get a runner out to fetch the relief column
Keep every prisoner alive

missions.title: Cardinal
missions.event: Hiroshima and Nagasaki are destroyed and the Soviet Union invades Manchuria. Japan announces its surrender, and an OSS team parachutes into Mukden to reach the Allied prisoners at Hoten camp.
objectives: Regroup after the scattered drop
Reach the camp without a firefight
Persuade the commandant to stand down
Protect the prisoners until the Soviets arrive

missions.title: Day 2,194
missions.event: Japan signs the Instrument of Surrender aboard USS Missouri. The Second World War is over.
